# Valid-file coverage fixtures (0.8.0 T01)

Inputs for `tests/compat/valid-file-manifest.json` and the `[valid-file]`
scoreboard. The manifest is the authority for ids, expected outcomes and
failure classes; this README records provenance.

## Generated fixtures

Everything below is produced by
[`generate_fixtures.py`](generate_fixtures.py). The generated bytes are
committed because ADR-0029 requires byte-exact fixtures; regenerating the
generated files is deterministic.

```powershell
python tests/fixtures/valid-file/generate_fixtures.py
```

| File | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| `step-alias.stpnc`, `step-alias.p21`, `step-alias.210` | Copies of the repository-generated `tests/fixtures/stp-spike/part_ap214.stp`; valid STEP bytes behind an alias suffix |
| `line.dxf` | Open 3D `POLYLINE` with four vertices and three segments |
| `line.off` | OFF with three two-index edge faces and no triangles |
| `line.dae` | COLLADA `<lines>` primitive with three segments |
| `line.x3d` | X3D `IndexedLineSet` with three segments |
| `points.dae` | COLLADA `<points>` primitive with four vertices |
| `points.x3d` | X3D `PointSet` with four vertices |
| `wire.step` | AP214 `GEOMETRIC_CURVE_SET` / `POLYLINE`, edges only, no faces |
| `wire.igs` | Fixed-column IGES stream with two type-110 line entities |
| `wire.brep` | OCCT `CASCADE Topology` compound of two edges, no faces |
| `wire.FCStd` | ZIP package with `Document.xml` and the wire `PartShape.brp` |
| `renamed-glb.bin` | Copy of `interactive-viewer/test-assets/tri_tight.glb` |
| `renamed-dae.xml` | Copy of `tests/fixtures/assimp-spike/box.dae` |
| `renamed-dxf.txt` | Copy of `tests/fixtures/assimp-spike/triangle.dxf` |

The Assimp line/point fixtures were recorded as typed failures in the T01
baseline. T04 normalizes one-index faces to `PointList` and two-index faces to
`LineList`, so `line.dxf`, `line.off`, `line.dae`, `line.x3d` and
`points.x3d` now open. COLLADA `<points>` is not represented by Assimp's
COLLADA importer (it has no point primitive); `points.dae` therefore remains a
typed `EmptyGeometry` failure rather than being misreported through a
synthetic skeleton mesh.

The four `wire.*` fixtures were also typed `EmptyGeometry` failures in the T01
baseline. T05 adds the CAD host's edge fallback: a definition with no
triangles is meshed through the same versioned deflection profile and emitted
as `LineList` segments. `wire.step`, `wire.igs`, `wire.brep` and `wire.FCStd`
now open with visible lines and verified finite bounds; the solid fixtures
keep triangle-only output. The IGES fixture's global-section Hollerith lengths
are generated from the actual strings (`8Hwire.igs`, `9HPreview3D`) so the
pinned parser reads the millimetre unit flag at the correct field.

## Real-world samples

The following files are copied from the local F3D checkout
(`testing/data/`). Their provenance is the F3D `DATA_LICENSES.md` list; only
files with a recorded redistributable license are used. Pass
`--f3d-data <path>` to `generate_fixtures.py` to refresh the copies.

| File | Source / license |
| --- | --- |
| `teapot.off` | Utah Teapot, public domain |
| `PinkEggFromLW.dxf` | Assimp test models, BSD-3-Clause |
| `cube_gears.3mf` | 3MF consortium samples, BSD-2-Clause |
| `animatedWorld.fbx` | VTK Data, BSD-3-Clause |

`cube_gears.3mf` currently fails typed with `ArchiveLimit`; that is a measured
resource-class gap for T09, not a license or fixture problem.
